'''Quay'va''' was, according to [[Weequay/Legends|Weequay]] mythology, a [[Gender/Legends|female]] warrior priestess who was created by the [[Deity/Legends|god]] [[Sri'quay'va]] and given power over fire. She killed the warrior [[Luur]] before being imprisoned by [[Quay (deity)|Quay]].<ref name="LoNH" />

When the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] traveled to [[Sriluur/Legends|Sriluur]], they misinterpreted Quay'va's name as '''Cueva'''.<ref name="LoNH" />
